reason: The README describes a chat plugin that accepts dragged or pasted images, stores them in the session workspace, and supplies file paths to text-only models, making media-tools the primary category.

summaries.zh: 将拖入或粘贴的图片保存到会话工作区，并在纯文本模型对话中插入图片文件路径。
summaries.en: Saves dragged or pasted images to the session workspace and inserts their file paths into conversations with text-only models.

capabilities: Intercepts dragged or pasted images in chat input
Validates and writes image files to the session workspace
Deduplicates stored images using SHA-256 content addressing
Inserts saved image paths into the model input
